output.question: Who owns NewsBreak?
output.answer: NewsBreak is owned by Particle Media, Inc., a privately held Delaware company, and NewsBreak is its trade name and consumer brand. Particle Media was founded in 2015 by former Yahoo executive Jeff Zheng, who is still CEO, together with co-founder Ren Xuyang. It is owned by its founders, employees and investors. Francisco Partners led the $115 million Series C in 2021 and holds a board seat. Earlier backers named by secondary sources include IDG Capital, NetEase, ZhenFund and Grand View Capital. The Chinese news aggregator Yidian Zixun was an early investor but is reported to have sold its stake in 2019. The company has not disclosed how ownership is split among its holders.

key_facts.fact: NewsBreak is a trade name of Particle Media, Inc., which was founded and is led by CEO Jeff Zheng.
Particle Media, Inc. is a Delaware company. It was founded in 2015 by Jeff Zheng, formerly of Yahoo, and co-founder Ren Xuyang.
Francisco Partners invested in NewsBreak's $115 million Series C round in 2021 and joined the board of directors.
Harry Shum, a former Microsoft AI and Research executive, became chairman of the board in 2020.
Yidian Zixun was an early investor in Particle Media and divested in 2019.
Earlier investors reportedly include IDG Capital, NetEase, ZhenFund and Grand View Capital.
